note: Thirst (Dave 2026-10-21): hydration holds up to thirst.cap_ml; it falls rest_ml_day plus work_ml_day x exertion a game day, so a full body lasts at least one game day even at full exertion and needs one drink a day. A mouthful at the water edge gives drink_ml (the server checks water within reach_m of the feet); drink items give ml from the drink table. Empty thirst stops health recovering; nothing else yet. Hunger, health and body weight as an energy balance (Dave 2026-10-20). A stomach holds up to stomach_cap_kcal; the body burns rest_kcal_per_kg_day x weight a day plus work_kcal_day x exertion (0 to 1, from how fast the player moves and tool work). A full stomach lasts at least one game day (24 game hours = 1 real hour at the 24:1 clock) at ordinary activity. When the stomach is empty the shortfall is burnt from the body: weight falls kcal/kcal_per_kg. Eating beyond a full stomach (up to overeat_allowance) turns the surplus into weight at gain_efficiency. Health recovers slowly while the stomach is not empty. Nothing here can kill. food = kcal per item: by_id wins over by_suffix (an item id that ends with the word). Plants whose flora uses include poison give nothing.

breath.note: Dave 2026-10-21: an oxygen symbol with a countdown (seconds) shows only with the head under water; the air lasts seconds at ordinary swimming pace, runs down rest_mult as fast resting or floating still (up to rest_speed m/s), hard_mult as fast swimming hard (from hard_speed m/s), and is full again the instant the head is above the surface. At zero the player loses drown_per_s health a second. can_die false: health stops at 1 until there is a death and respawn system.
